normalization: Project mode, fixed context archive placeholder; schema structure included. Character counts are not tokens.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read current text from a file, not a directory. Use for known paths.
tools.promptSnippet: read: Read current file contents or selected lines.

filePath.description: Required file path (or path alias); relative to cwd or absolute anywhere

limit.description: Line count, not ending line; default 400

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run shell commands in cwd. Returns stdout, stderr and exit_code; check the exit code. For truncated output, read the reported Full output path instead of rerunning. Also readable: session context archive at /SESSION_CONTEXT (compacted history + spilled tool outputs).
tools.promptSnippet: bash: Run shell commands; use rg for current text, regex, or all matches.

tools.name: edit
tools.description: Replace exact text in a file. Read the target first; include surrounding text to distinguish duplicate matches.
tools.promptSnippet: edit: Replace exact text within a file.

filePath.description: Required file path or path alias; relative to cwd, within cwd/global Skill directories

oldString.description: Required nonempty text; must match once unless replaceAll=true

newString.description: Replacement text; empty or omitted deletes the match

replaceAll.description: Replace every exact match; default false

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully overwrite a text file, creating parent directories. For partial changes use edit.
tools.promptSnippet: write: Create or fully overwrite a text file.

filePath.description: Required file path or path alias; relative to cwd, within cwd/global Skill directories

tools.name: code_search
tools.description: Search a potentially stale index by literal keywords, not semantic similarity. Returns ranked paths, line ranges and one snippet per file. Empty results do not prove absence; use rg for current or exhaustive matches.
tools.promptSnippet: code_search: Find relevant files by indexed keywords, with ranked snippets.

query.description: Literal code keywords; translate natural-language intent into likely identifiers or terms

path.description: Restrict to files under this relative path

tools.name: codegraph
tools.description: Query the code graph. Known symbol names can be used directly, without search/status first. impact includes the target and file nodes but no per-node depth; traverse callers for exact call layers. Verify incomplete graph evidence against source.
tools.promptSnippet: codegraph: Find indexed symbol definitions, callers, callees, and change impact.

action.description: search: definitions; callers: who directly calls a symbol; callees: what it directly calls; impact: affected nodes; status: index diagnostics

symbol.description: Required for callers/callees/impact: symbol name (node.name), not node.id

kind.description: Optional search kind, e.g. function, class, method, interface, component

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Delegate tasks to isolated agents that do not share this conversation. Use direct tools for simple lookups or quick edits.
tools.promptSnippet: subagent: Delegate research, coding, or review to other agents.

message.description: Self-contained task: goal, context, constraints and expected output.

mode.description: ask = read-only research; code = isolated coding with diff; parallel = multiple independent attempts (default 3); review = dedicated review pass. Omit to auto-infer.

workflow.description: parallel: concurrent (default); sequential: ordered, sharing prior conclusions; pipeline: each output feeds the next. Omit to auto-infer.

name.description: Short label for the worker, e.g. '方案 A' / 'Security Review'.

task.description: Self-contained instructions for this worker. Include the goal and any constraints.

dependsOn.description: Names of prior workers this one depends on (pipeline/sequential). Omit to infer sequential order.

workers.description: Custom worker breakdown. Maximum 5 workers. Omit to let the planner auto-build workers from the mode.

summary:
- read: Read current file contents or selected lines.
- bash: Run shell commands; use rg for current text, regex, or all matches.
- edit: Replace exact text within a file.
- write: Create or fully overwrite a text file.
- code_search: Find relevant files by indexed keywords, with ranked snippets.
- codegraph: Find indexed symbol definitions, callers, callees, and change impact.
- subagent: Delegate research, coding, or review to other agents.
